correction_of.reason: The batch of the root frozen plan ran against the sources of the first submission.  It failed with twenty failures of six root causes: one production defect (a thread attribute that shadowed the internal method of the base class of the thread) and five defects of the checks of the batch.  The failures are preserved and the sources are corrected; the correction needs a new plan and a new acknowledgement of the root because the pins of the executed plan bind the sources of the first submission.

entry: The runner of this directory.  The test module has no entry point of its own and it is not an authorised entry.
failure_policy: Every failure is kept.  There is no automatic rerun, no additional node and no other route.  A failed batch is reported as a failed batch.
label: native-custody-correction-02

root_decisions.ctypes_preload: The one finite preload window of the standard library is the only exception of the guard and it is counted in its own receipt field.
root_decisions.deadline_aware_peer: A handle of the broker has to say that it understands an absolute deadline.  A handle that does not say so is never assumed to be deadline aware.
root_decisions.frame_budget: The frames of the channel are shared by both directions, the frames of the terminal exchange are reserved and the budget is never widened.
root_decisions.heartbeat: The heartbeat of the parent is 60 seconds and the missing window of the broker is 120 seconds.  Only a confirmed frame refreshes the liveness of the round and the heartbeat never extends the absolute deadline.
root_decisions.transport: The bounded transport of the private channel is the POSIX endpoint on the original descriptor and the supervised and cancellable Windows endpoint on the original handle.  The read and the write of the Windows endpoint each own one worker thread, the supervisor never performs the blocking call itself, the cancellation is a request and the completion is proven by the worker.

scope: One offline validation batch of the complete N1 subtree after the N1 correction 02.  The three N1 sources changed in this round, so the batch is the complete subtree of tools/test_v0_s3_native_custody.py and not a subset: the eleven major findings and the one minor finding of the independent review of msg_287dbc62810a are the subject of the batch, together with the new negative cases that they needed.  It is not a rerun of the fifty four nodes of the historical batch and it is not a rerun of the thirty two nodes of the correction 01 batch.  No native execution, no service, no model, no GPU, no port, no media, no network, no download, no process, no socket, no database and no ledger.

stdlib_preload.reason: ctypes/__init__.py loads the image of the process itself with PyDLL(None) when the standard library is imported.  The window lets exactly that one event pass and it is closed for good right afterwards.  Every other dlopen, every dlsym and every named library stays refused.
